clock_semantics.cpu_submit_ms: host perf_counter_ns interval surrounding only the eager call/replay loop; start/end event record, elapsed_time and synchronization are excluded
clock_semantics.device_interval_ms: precreated timing Event interval recorded start->end on the same explicit measurement stream; ordered device markers, not proven busy-kernel time
clock_semantics.wall_complete_ms: host perf_counter_ns interval from before the start event submission through the end-event completion wait

interpretation.derived: per-invocation values are derived block/N descriptions; N is declared API invocations, not measured kernel launches
interpretation.native_outputs: RMSNorm/SwiGLU use native default outputs only; no .out or preallocated-output overload is claimed
interpretation.allocation_pool: native allocation addresses and graph private-pool reuse are recorded separately from eager allocator diagnostics; timing differences are not labelled pure host dispatch cost
interpretation.copy: one same preallocated destination is written repeatedly; this is local contiguous copy, not a D2D/cache-scatter claim
interpretation.debug_dump: an optional structural dump is not a measured task count and its failure does not invalidate otherwise good replay timing

note: Schema illustration only. It records a deliberate no-device setup failure, zero raw timing blocks, zero measured or measurement-complete conditions and no timing claims. It is not evidence from an NPU run.
